name: K-1 Fiancé(e) Visa

requirements.blocker_text: This requires the petitioner to be a US CITIZEN specifically — lawful permanent residents cannot file a K-1 petition.
This requires having met in person within the 2 years before filing, and intending to marry within 90 days of the fiancé(e)'s entry to the US.

evidence_required.document: Evidence of a genuine relationship and intent to marry

outcome.duration_length: 90 days to marry after entry; then must adjust status

notes: Genuinely time-pressured structure: 90 days to marry after entry, or the holder falls out of status entirely with no extension available — a real hard deadline distinct from most other family routes in this dataset. K-2 children (unmarried, under 21) must be listed on the same I-129F petition from the start; they cannot be added later. citizenship_after_months (36) uses the 3-year marriage-based track (married to and living with a US citizen), the faster of the two naturalisation timelines (see us_naturalisation).
